violation_type.title: Required Admission Information-Physician Information (26 TAC §744.605(11))
violation_type.typical_finding: Child files were reviewed.  1 child still needs health care information for admission form.

finding_variants.text: Child files were reviewed.  1 child still needs health care information for admission form.
Authorization to obtain emergency medical care and to transport the child for emergency  medical treatment needs to be available for review for child enrollment forms.
Two student files that were reviewed did not give medical authorization.
One child did not have information of name, address, and telephone number of the child's physician or an emergency-care facility in the admission form.
4 out of 4 children's files did not have the doctor or hospital's name, address and phone number.
A child's file was missing physician/emergency care facility information.
